purpose: A two-country East Africa safari combining Tanzania's northern circuit with Kenya's Maasai Mara, plus a Zanzibar coast finish
routeRationale: Arusha as gateway, then Tarangire, Ngorongoro and Serengeti form a coherent northern circuit; a short flight crosses into the Mara to add Kenya without wasted road time; Zanzibar closes the trip with rest and culture
assumptions: Fly-drive: internal flights between Serengeti, Mara and Zanzibar; 4x4 game drive vehicles in parks
Kenya-Tanzania border crossed by air, not road, to save a day and avoid rough tracks
One special meal reserved for a Zanzibar seafood dinner
Malaria prophylaxis and yellow fever/visa rules for both countries must be verified
Grumeti/Mara river crossings are seasonal and cannot be guaranteed
tradeoffs: Skips Kilimanjaro and Lake Manyara to keep the circuit unhurried
Crosses into Kenya by light aircraft rather than road, sacrificing a scenic drive for reliability
One lighter cultural day in Arusha area rather than a full city stay
Zanzibar finish trades an extra safari day for coastal rest as requested
